name: @pipeworx/mcp-tomtom

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Geocoding: convert an address, place name, or free-text location query into geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude). Returns formatted address, country, lat, lon, type, and match score. Example: geocode({ query: "350 5th Ave, New York" })

query.description: Address or place to geocode, e.g. "350 5th Ave, New York" or "Eiffel Tower"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own TomTom API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: search_poi
tools.description: Search for points of interest (POIs) — businesses, landmarks, restaurants, gas stations, etc. — by name or category, optionally near a lat/lon center within a radius. Returns name, category, address, coordinates, phone, url, and distance. Example: search_poi({ query: "coffee", lat: 40.748, lon: -73.985, radius: 1000 })

lat.description: Optional latitude of the search center to bias/limit results

lon.description: Optional longitude of the search center to bias/limit results

radius.description: Optional search radius in meters (only used when lat/lon are provided)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own TomTom API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Reverse geocoding: convert latitude/longitude coordinates into a human-readable street address. Returns the freeform address, country, municipality, street name, postal code, and position. Example: reverse_geocode({ lat: 40.748, lon: -73.985 })

lat.description: Latitude of the point to reverse geocode

lon.description: Longitude of the point to reverse geocode

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own TomTom API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Traffic-aware routing / directions: calculate the best route between two points and return distance plus travel time computed with live traffic. Reports traffic delay so you get realistic ETAs, not free-flow estimates. Supports car, truck, pedestrian, and bicycle travel modes. Example: route({ from_lat: 40.748, from_lon: -73.985, to_lat: 40.689, to_lon: -74.044 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own TomTom API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tomtom forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tomtom pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
